title: Wire continuity Nostr serialization and reactor handlers
intent: Expose the continuity domain contracts through Nostr-native event serialization and thin control-plane reactor dispatch without introducing runtime engine behavior.
observed_behavior: Continuity domain types existed, but continuity Nostr kinds were not encoded, decoded, subscribed, or converted into internal in-process events.
intended_behavior: Kinds 31400-31404, 30350, 38430, and 38431 have deterministic serialization/validation helpers. The reactor subscribes to those kinds, validates inbound Nostr events through the existing reactor path, deduplicates them, decodes kind-specific tags/content, and emits typed internal events for downstream continuity engines.
scope: internal/adapters/nostr continuity codec and kind constants
internal/events continuity event constants and payloads
